A1.reason: Same set only counts customers; this shows per table the rows added, updated and deleted, the columns touched, how many rows hold the fixed status value, and whether any table, column or row count outside the agreement was touched, all before the promotion (C2, C4, and the row side of C1).

A2.reason: Between the promotion and the release request the worker tidies the staging area where the undo data is kept, so only a fresh rehearsal at A2 can show that the promotion can still be reversed when the release is asked for (C7).

C8.for_what_part: The release check shows that the released recipients are exactly the promoted customers and that the released wording is the approved wording. Sent as released shows that the recipients and wording of the sending calls match the release, but only for calls ordered before it was taken. Sending or preview calls made outside the release have to be found by querying the record.

C9.for_what_part: It shows the sending calls confirmed and those ordered and not confirmed, matched against the release, as of the time it is taken. A call ordered after that time is outside it, and duplicate or out-of-release calls are also checked by querying the record.
